headline: Sources: Steelers to trade Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys
summary: The Steelers have agreed to trade cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources confirmed to ESPN.

headline: Lamar Jackson, Ravens looking for first home win since before Thanksgiving
summary: Once among the most dominant teams at home, the Ravens have lost four straight games in Baltimore.

headline: Packers' O-line leaves Jordan Love under constant pressure
summary: The Packers have allowed more "quick pressures" against Love than any team in the NFL -- and it's not close.

headline: Browns' QB situation takes a turn as Deshaun Watson finds his footing
summary: Cleveland's 2-1 start and the QB's late-game performances have helped to shift the conversation around the future of the position.

headline: Why Darnell Washington has become the Steelers' X factor
summary: At 6-foot-7 and nearly 300 pounds, the Pittsburgh tight end is more than a viral hurdle highlight reel.
